text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wall of the Kikuka Sho was thick and 
towering. Even so, she had not lost her 
pride. With an indomitable spirit, she set 
her sights on her next challenge: the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After watching the champion run, Narita 
Brian arrived in the waiting room. Amid 
the tense conversation—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To Symboli Rudolf, who is preoccupied with 
the student council to the very end, 
Narita Brian delivers a sharp observation.
